rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING BROADER PROTECTION TO CONSUMERS AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7394, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS "THE CONSUMER ACT OF THE PHILIPPINES"
rows.abstract:
Proposes new provisions to the law to include eight (8) Consumer Bill of Rights and five (5) Consumer Responsibilities; Provides an article mandating the English or Filipino translation of product labels written in foreign characters or languages; Proposes to permanently ban suppliers who engaged in the importation of defective goods.
Intends to expand provisions on advertising and promotion,  to include those products, services, and credit facilities with sponsorships of programs, concerts, games, shows, and similar activities; Includes in the definition of “Mass Media” - internet, mobile phones, and similar electronic devices.; Proposes the automatic shutting down of any establishments caught in flagrante delicto selling, producing, or importing substandard and hazardous products.

rows.author: I061
rows.title_full: AN ACT SETTING A CEILING TO THE INDEBTEDNESS OF THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES TO ENSURE MACRO-ECONOMIC STABILITY AND SUSTAINABLE GROWTH AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Proposes to put a cap on the total indebtedness of the national government and any of its agencies, offices, GOCCs at 50% of the latest GDP to secure the prevention of potential negative impacts of high pubic debt on economic activity.

Provides that the debt ceiling may be breached only when there are extraneous events beyond the control of the government subject to Presidential certification, and approval of Congress.

Mandates the Chief Executive to go back to Congress and seek authority to borrow more in the event that the national government fiscal deficit target submitted by the President is breached before the end of the fiscal year.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2019-09-13

rows.abstract:
Seeks to replace the unitary or single income tax rate with a graduated income tax schedule for corporate taxpayers to align with the constitutional mandate of a progressive system of taxation and the rule on a uniform and equitable taxation.

 Proposes to lower the corporate income tax rate of domestic and resident foreign corporations with graduated rates ranging from 5% to 25%;  and for a non-resident foreign corporation (not engaged in a trade or business in the Philippines), a tax rate equal to 25% of the gross income received during each taxable year from all sources within the Philippines,. . .

rows.abstract:
Aims to address the worsening traffic situation in the country by solving the existing inadequacies in our laws and promoting the safety and welfare of people who patronize the more commonly known \"habal-habal\" or \"angkas\" as an alternative to other modes of public transportation.

Includes the new term \"MOTORCYCLES-FOR-HIRE in Sec.3 of R.A. 4136 which shall be defined as follows:

\" ( N ) MOTORCYCLES-FOR-HIRE - ANY TWO-WHEELED MOTOR VEHICLE THAT MAY BE REGISTERED WITH THE LTO AS FOR HIRE AND MAY BE USED AS A COMMERCIAL VEHICLE TO TRANSPORT PASSENGERS AND GOODS:  PROVIDED, THAT, FOR TRANSPORTING PASSENGERS, THE MOTORCYCLE SHALL HAVE A MINIMUM ENGINE DISPLACEMENT OF 125 CUBIC CENTIMETERS AND A BACKBONE TYPE BUILT. \"

rows.abstract:
Provides for several amendments and/or insertions to Sec.53, Art.VII of B.P.881, which
includes, among others:
Sec.53-A. "AUTOMATIC CREATION OF POSITIONS OF ELECTION OFFICERS...";
Sec.53-B. "RATIO OF ELECTION ASSISTANTS TO REGISTERED VOTERS...";
Sec.53-C. "NO OTHER PERSONNEL, OTHER THAN THOSE MENTIONED IN SEC.53 HEREOF, OR EXPRESSLY AUTHORIZED BY LAW, SHALL BE ASSIGNED, DESIGNATED, ENGAGED OR DETAILED AT THE COMMISSIONS'S FIELD OFFICES, OR SHALL BE ALLOWED TO PERFORM ADMINISTRATIVE OR CLERICAL WORKS IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE MANDATE OF THE FIELD OFFICES ..." 

Also provides for an amended Sec. 55 which shall be read as follows:
"COMELEC SHALL PROVIDE AN ACCESSIBLE AND SUITABLE PLACE FOR ITS FIELD OFFICERS AND THEIR STAFF, CHARGEABLE TO ITS YEARLY APPROPRIATIONS."

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE PROGRAM ON PREVENTING AND COUNTERING VIOLENT EXTREMISM AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Intends to fill in the gap the inadequacies of R.A.No.11054, the \"Organic Law for the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao\" which aims to address the armed conflict between Moro separatist factions and the government forces; and the existence of extremist groups such as the Abu Sayyaf Group (ASG) which engage in terror attacks, kidnapping, arson and other forms of violence.

Seeks to introduce a third program for rebels which aims to establish the Program on Preventing and Countering Violent Extremism ( P C V E ); envisions to be a national program similar to Enhanced Comprehensive Local Integration Program ( E - C L I P ) and the Payapa at Masaganang Pamayanan ( P A M A N A ) Program.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2019-09-16

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING RACIAL, ETHNIC AND RELIGIOUS DISCRIMINATION
rows.abstract:
Defines several terms among others such as ETHNIC ORIGIN, ETHNO LINGUISTIC GROUP, INDIGENOUS PEOPLES,
STEREOTYPE/STEREOTYPING, et.al.

Provides for several ACTS OF DISCRIMINATION which are deemed discriminatory and shall be prohibited: 
discrimination in : political participation; employment; education and training; delivery of goods and services; land, business and other accommodation; access to public places, facilities, and public meetings; advertisements/mass media; discrimination : by wrongful portrayal; through speech, utterances, acts of hatred and similar act, through analogous acts that result in impairment of the enjoyment of human rights and fundamental freedoms; through engaging in profiling; and through abuses of state and non - state actors.
